description.text: ex Start Decks: eight ready-built 60-card decks, one per type, led by Decidueye ex, Victini ex, Greninja ex, Miraidon ex, Clefable ex, Koraidon ex, Houndoom ex and Melmetal ex, each with a sheet of damage counters and markers. A Random ex Start Deck held one of these eight or one of two special decks. All the cards are non-holo. This set holds the cards of all ten.
